stories.title: Stories
stories.intro: How a Kwento: Kilabot story goes from an idea to a published video.

steps.title: Pick the next topic
steps.text: The next topic comes from a queue of Filipino folklore ideas, so there is always a story ready to make.

steps.title: Write the story
steps.text: Claude writes a Tagalog horror script in clip-sized beats: a hook, a build and a twist, with an angle viewers have not seen before.

steps.title: Write the prompts
steps.text: Every narration line gets a vertical video prompt that shows what is being said. The narrator stays off screen, so nobody on screen lip-syncs.

steps.title: Generate in Google Flow
steps.text: The clips are generated in Google Flow, one prompt per clip.

steps.title: Edit and sync
steps.text: The clips are joined and the voice-over is locked to the picture.

steps.title: Quality check
steps.text: Automatic checks and a visual review catch black frames, cut-off narration, wrong scenes, text overlays and lip movement before anything is delivered.

steps.title: Publish and showcase
steps.text: The video is posted to Facebook and YouTube, then added to this portfolio with a NEW badge for its first week.

ads.title: Ads
ads.intro: How a TikTok Shop ad is made, from a product listing to a published video.

steps.title: Pick a product
steps.text: A product from my TikTok Shop showcase, studied for what it does and how people really use it.

steps.title: Write the ad
steps.text: Claude writes a Taglish, UGC-style script with an honest angle. Every claim comes from the product listing.

steps.title: Write the prompts
steps.text: Prompts keep the product looking exactly like its listing photo, with the Ate Host speaking on camera and silent hero shots in between.

steps.title: Generate in Google Flow
steps.text: Narrated clips use the Ate Host character, and product hero shots use Veo.

steps.title: Edit and sync
steps.text: The clips are joined and the voice-over is locked to the picture.

steps.title: Quality check
steps.text: The same checks as every video, plus a minimum length and a product-accuracy check.

steps.title: Approve, post and showcase
steps.text: I approve each ad before it goes to TikTok with the product linked, then it is added to this portfolio.

kids.title: Kids
kids.intro: The same video pipeline, used for videos made for kids.

steps.title: Choose the idea
steps.text: Start from what the video should show or teach.

steps.title: Write the script
steps.text: Claude writes the script in clip-sized beats.

steps.title: Write the prompts
steps.text: Every line gets a prompt that shows what is being said.

steps.title: Generate in Google Flow
steps.text: The clips are generated in Google Flow.

steps.title: Quality check
steps.text: Every clip is checked before it is delivered.

steps.title: Publish and showcase
steps.text: The finished video is added to this portfolio.

apps.title: Applications
apps.intro: How a web or mobile application goes from an idea to a live link.
apps.note: A working outline that will grow as I add more Claude skills for building apps.

steps.title: Define the app
steps.text: Start from the problem and the people who will use it, and decide what the first version has to do.

steps.title: Build with Claude
steps.text: Claude helps write and review the code, trace bugs and draft the documentation.

steps.title: Test and refine
steps.text: Check it on the web and on mobile, and fix what breaks.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.text: Publish the web app or package the mobile app.

steps.title: Showcase
steps.text: The app is added to this studio with a live link and its source.
